archetypes.name: Psycho
archetypes.blurb: The irrational visionary. Absolute focus, unbothered by standard risk paradigms, social embarrassment, or logical limitations.

archetypes.name: Killer
archetypes.blurb: The acutely competent predator. Physical confidence and assertiveness; refusal to enter a subservient state of explaining oneself.

archetypes.name: Trickster
archetypes.blurb: The intuitive action force. Immediate action on unearned confidence, turning error and chaos into progress.

archetypes.name: Beast
archetypes.blurb: Primal desire. Raw drive without sterile guilt, social policing, or self-sabotaging shame.

campaigns.title: The First Week
campaigns.subtitle: Seven days of saying the thing.
campaigns.intro_md: Seven days. One act a day, each one small enough that you cannot reasonably claim it was impossible, and large enough that you will want to skip it.

day_bodies.body_md: [PLACEHOLDER] Today is about being audible. Not louder -- audible.
[PLACEHOLDER] Today you find out what you have been going without.
[PLACEHOLDER] Today the sentence ends where you end it.
[PLACEHOLDER] Today you stop waiting to be invited.
[PLACEHOLDER] Today costs something. That is how you know it counted.
[PLACEHOLDER] Today you take the road you would rather not.
[PLACEHOLDER] Today is the one you have been circling all week.

actions.title: [PLACEHOLDER] Say the thing you have been not saying

action_bodies.body_md: [PLACEHOLDER] Where two options exist today and one is easier, take the other.
[PLACEHOLDER] Ask one person for one thing you would normally not bother asking for.
[PLACEHOLDER] You already know what it is. Say it to the person it concerns.
[PLACEHOLDER] Say the disagreeing thing once, while the subject is still open.
[PLACEHOLDER] Say no once today, and stop talking after you have said it.
[PLACEHOLDER] Once today, when someone asks what you want, answer immediately and do not soften it.
[PLACEHOLDER] In one conversation today, be the first to speak.

doctrine_groups.title: The Zoo
doctrine_groups.blurb: The enclosure you did not choose.

doctrine_groups.title: Thumos
doctrine_groups.blurb: The spirited part, and what it is for.

doctrine_entries.title: The Domesticated State
doctrine_entries.body_md: Safety, predictability and a single-file path, traded for the ability to choose your own. Nobody forced it on you. That is what makes it hard to see.

doctrine_entries.title: Thought Corruption
doctrine_entries.body_md: Reading about it is not doing it. Collecting one more framework is the most comfortable way to avoid acting, because it feels like progress.

doctrine_entries.title: Thumos
doctrine_entries.body_md: The drive to be seen, to assert, to leave a mark on the physical world. Not willpower and not grit — both of those lose the half about being seen.
